Get the app

Compute Screener installs from your browser. It gets its own icon on your home screen and opens full screen, with today's compute prices: GPU rental, compute futures and AI token prices. Free, with no app store and no account.

Compute Screener
Free compute prices
Installed

iPhone and iPad

  1. Open computescreener.com in Safari.
  2. Tap Share. On iOS 26, tap ⋯ beside the address bar first, then Share.
  3. Tap Add to Home Screen, leave Open as Web App on, and tap Add.

Android

  1. Open computescreener.com in Chrome.
  2. Tap ⋮ at the top right, then Add to Home screen (or Install app).
  3. Tap Install.

Computer

In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or choose install in the browser's menu. The app opens in its own window.
